caption: The drawing depicts a single large handbag or travel bag set against a plain, light beige background. The bag is predominantly purple in color, with a textured or fabric-like appearance. It has dark green decorative patterns bordering the front panel in an ornate, symmetrical design, resembling floral or geometric motifs. In the center of the front panel, there is a large, stylized letter "B" in dark green. The bag features black or dark brown handles and a metallic, gold-colored clasp at the top center, which is attached with a small round fastener. The side and bottom edges of the bag have visible shading in black and gray, indicating depth and volume. The overall orientation of the bag is upright with the handles arching over the top.
title: Carpet Bag
